video.title: AI欧腐《与你为敌/Against You, I Fight》
video.desc:
这部未完结哈 看了看开头感觉还可以 行了 忙完了
Two rival basketball stars are enemies on the court, but one has been secretly in love with the other for five years! When Jasper finds Ian's five diaries, everything changes. Their chemistry on the court was undeniable. Off the court, it was explosive. The rivalry was real. So was love.

两位互为劲敌的篮球明星在球场上水火不容，可其中一人竟然偷偷爱了对方整整五年！当 Jasper 发现了 Ian 的五本日记，一切都变了。球场上，他们之间的默契无可否认；球场下，他们之间的火花一触即燃。敌对是真的，爱也是真的。
